test_title: PYST 3: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to improve it, select ‘No improvement required’.

__It is I who am__ responsible for the success of the organization.
solution:
The correct answer is 'No improvement required.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the underlined segment of the sentence, no improvement or correction is required.
 
• The given sentence is talking about someone who is the reason behind the success of the organization.
 
• The pronoun 'It' is correct as it is used **to identify a person**.
 
• The **singular verb 'is'** is correctly used with the **singular subject 'It'**.
 
• The **pro**noun 'who' is correctly used as it is used **to introduce a clause giving further information about a person or people previously mentioned**. Also, the verb should be according to the antecedent of the pronoun given. 
 
• 
 
The verb '**Am**' is correctly used with the **first person singular 'I'**.

 

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

Correct sentence: ***It is I who am** responsible for the success of the organization*.
